 Set message & journey capping rules | Adobe Journey Optimizer Documentation Journey Optimizer Journey Optimizer Guide Set message & journey capping rules section-overview Last update: April 15, 2026 Capping rules are part of conflict management & prioritization — they help ensure customers receive the right amount of communication without feeling overwhelmed. Before applying rules, use the conflict detection tool to identify overlapping journeys and campaigns. When multiple communications qualify for the same profile, priority scores determine which message is delivered first. You can set limits on how often messages are sent (frequency capping), how many journeys a profile can enter (journey capping), and when messages are blocked (quiet hours). Rules are grouped into rule sets and applied to campaigns or journeys. For programmatic control from external systems, see the Capping API . Set message & Journey capping rules Work with Rule Sets Learn how to create, manage, and activate rule sets to control message frequency and journey entry rules in Adobe Journey Optimizer. Explore Rule Sets Journey Capping & Arbitration Discover how to set journey entry and concurrency caps, prioritize journeys, and monitor exclusions to prevent communication overload. Learn Journey Capping Frequency Capping by Channel Understand how to create and apply channel-specific frequency capping rules to optimize message delivery and avoid over-communication. Set Frequency Capping Set Quiet Hours Define time-based exclusions for Email, SMS, Push, and WhatsApp so no messages are sent during specific periods — respecting customer preferences and compliance.
